text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PD-4821 fired for Mistral Health (reserved-tenant-mistral). Alert: reserved pool `mistral-reserved-01` high latency + increased 5xxs. Trigger: `p95_latency > 1200ms` and `5xx_rate > 5%`

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://pd/recent/PD-4821 — urgency: high — assigned to sam (oncall)

sam (oncall): Ack'd. I'm on it. Can someone grab quick impact numbers and whether KV cache evictions are happening?

maya (eng-oncall): On it. Pulling metrics now.

maya (eng-oncall): curl to metrics endpoint:
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query_range?query=tenant_p95_latency{tenant=\"mistral\"}&start=-5m&end=now&step=15s" | jq '.'
```

maya (eng-oncall): Quick paste of recent metrics (5m window):
```
{
  "tenant_p95_latency": "1300ms -> 1800ms spike",
  "5xx_rate": "0.6 -> 7.4%",
  "kvcache_evictions": "ejections/sec 0.02 -> 12.5"
}
```

lee (sre-lead): Sounds like KV cache thrash + OOM-pressure causing slowdowns. Any OOMs in node logs?

maya (eng-oncall): Grepping kube logs now. Short log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-14T17:01:02Z] mistral-reserved-01/pod-12: WARN memory: soft OOM triggered, reclaim failed
[2026-03-14T17:01:07Z] mistral-reserved-01/pod-14: ERROR runtime: allocate failed: out of memory
[2026-03-14T17:02:10Z] mistral-reserved-01/pod-09: INFO evicting kv cache shard 7
```

sam (oncall): Confirmed. Looks like soft-OOMs causing degraded tail latency and evictions. Immediate mitigations: 1) scale reserved pool, 2) route critical traffic to fallback variant, 3) reduce batch size on inference config. Who can run the scale?

maya (eng-oncall): I can scale. Running `kubectl -n reserved scale deployment mistral-reserved --replicas=12`

ops-bot: Command accepted. Executing scale request...

ops-bot: `kubectl` output: scaled deployment mistral-reserved from 6 to 12 replicas (rolling update started)

maya (eng-oncall): Scaling in progress. Also pushing a temporary config to reduce `max_batch_tokens` from 1024->512 for model variant `mistral-v1` on mistral-reserved-01: 
```
PATCH /v1/configs/mistral-reserved-01
{ "max_batch_tokens": 512 }
```

sam (oncall): Good. Also enabling routing policy to prefer fallback `mistral-lite` for non-SLA traffic: 
```
POST /v1/routing/update 
{ "tenant": "mistral", "policy":"prefer-fallback", "percent": 40 }
```

ops-bot: Routing update accepted. 40% of non-critical traffic shifted to `mistral-lite`.

maya (eng-oncall): After scale & config change (1min): metrics show p95 down from 1800ms -> 900ms, 5xx rate down to ~2.1%, kvcache_evictions dropping. Still seeing a handful of OOM logs but much reduced.

nina (customer-success): Reaching out to Mistral Health support lead (Samir) now. Customer reported spike in failed requests in integration tests. I'll keep them updated and offer a status bridge.

lee (sre-lead): Nice work. I'm escalating to PD escalation policy: paging infra oncall for deeper memory analysis — possible long-term mitigation: increase instance memory or tune GC/allocator.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4821 escalated to infra-sre (oncall). Notified lee.

sam (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall in 30m: we scaled pool, reduced batching, enabled routing fallback 40% for non-SLA. Customer-facing errors reduced to background noise but still monitoring. Setting bridge.

sam (oncall): Bridge link: https://zoom/bridge/incident-PD-4821 — joining now.

ops-bot: Bridge created, recording enabled.

maya (eng-oncall): Running deeper memory profile on a repro pod: `gcore` dump and `heap-prof` started. Uploading to `/tmp/incident/PD-4821/`

lee (sre-lead): Assigning postmortem to `eng-runtime/maya` and `platform/lee`. Please include: root cause, why autoscaler didn't preempt, follow-up: add proactive OOM alert and reserved pool memory headroom increase.

nina (customer-success): Customer update sent: "We've identified elevated memory pressure in the dedicated cluster and applied temporary mitigations (scaling, routing fallback). We're monitoring and will provide an RCA within 48 hours." Customer replied :thumbsup:.

sam (oncall): 15m status: p95 ~820ms, 5xx ~1.2%. Reqs normalizing. I'm going to clear the active page if trends hold for next 10m. Any objections?

lee (sre-lead): No objections. Make sure logs and traces are preserved.

sam (oncall): Clearing active page. Closing PD alert in 10m if stable.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4821 acknowledged by sam and set to resolved (pending closure after monitoring window).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident PD-4821: Mitigated. Summary: temporary P95 degradation due to soft-OOMs on mistral-reserved-01 leading to KV cache evictions. Mitigations applied: scaled reserved pool 6->12, reduced `max_batch_tokens`, shifted 40% non-SLA traffic to `mistral-lite`, initiated memory profiling and created bridge. Postmortem assigned.

sam (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving a short ops note for handoff: if recurrence, rollback `max_batch_tokens` and provision larger instance sizes for reserved pool.

nina (customer-success): I'll schedule the customer RCA sync for tomorrow.

lee (sre-lead): Closing notes: we should add an automated alert for `kvcache_evictions > 5/sec` and `oom_count > 0` per node to trigger earlier scale. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

sam (oncall): Thanks — handing off to night oncall.

maya (eng-oncall): Ending shift, monitoring until handoff complete.

ops-bot: Incident thread archived to /incidents/PD-4821. Logs and traces attached.
